answer: To join, an agent deposits collateral that is slashed if it creates duplicate identities, making mass fake accounts costly. Sybil resistance can be built through proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a meaningful stake before earning rewards. Like a glacier slowly carving a meadow, honest stake accumulates over time, while attackers risk losing real value. Reputation earned through genuine work becomes nectar that only verified, bonded agents can harvest. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
